```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  copilot-setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          activate-environment: false
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Sync dependencies
        run: uv sync --frozen

      - name: Verify pre-commit is available
        run: uvx pre-commit --version
```
